ety.text: From Proto-New Indo-Aryan *छट्ट- (chaṭṭa-) + Middle Indo-Aryan -𑀓𑁆𑀓- (-kka-). Cognate with Punjabi ਛਟੱਣਾ /چھٹنا (chaṭaṇṇā), Nepali छड़्कनु (chaṛkanu), Bengali ছটকান (choṭkan), Gujarati છટકવું (chaṭakvũ), Marathi सटकणे (saṭakṇe). Perhaps related with छड़ना (chaṛnā). See there for more.
